text:
deploy-bot: Promotion started: chart=payments-ui v3.2.0 -> eu-west-1 canary (canary-4)
oliver: Seeing lots of 400s from admission webhook on canary pods, logs show 'Invalid CRD version: v2beta1 not recognized'
maria: :eyes: did preflight include CRD compatibility check? we added a schema bump in chart 3.2.0
jon: Confirmed. Running kubectl logs shows webhook returning 422 for creation of PaymentMethod CR
sre-oncall: Pause rollout? We can either back out CRD change or pin to 3.1.5 for eu-west only
linda: How risky is a partial rollback of the CRD only? anything that needs DB migration?
maria: No DB migration. It's a server-side CRD validation change that rejects older manifests. Option A: rollback chart to 3.1.5 in eu-west canary (fast). Option B: patch webhook to accept legacy version (risky)
oliver: Prefer A. We can pin chart release for namespace=payments-canary with `helm upgrade --install payments -f values-patch.yaml --version 3.1.5`
jon: Command I'm going to run in a minute:
```
helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --namespace payments-canary --version 3.1.5 --reuse-values
kubectl rollout status deploy/payments-canary -n payments-canary
```
maria: +1. Also add release note: CRD schema bump reverted in eu-west canary pending follow-up migration plan. I'll update the release notes and call out to product
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary promotion paused by human (maria). Queue length 2. See https://deploy.example/release/4102
sre-oncall: After rollback, smoke test: create new PM resource and ensure webhook accepts it. I'll run smoke job: `ci/smoke/payment-crd-test.sh`
linda: Tagging @platform-qa and @product for visibility :eyes:
maria: Follow-up action: create a migration runbook to roll back to new schema safely. Assigning to @oliver for verification, @jon for helm pin script. I'll file a ticket: RW-5478
oliver: On it. Running helm pin now
deploy-bot: promotion remains paused in eu-west pending manual unpause
jon: Done. helm upgrade returned 0, pods are stable. rolling back CRD validation change fixed 400s
sre-oncall: smoke job passed :white_check_mark:
maria: OK, unpausing promotion for non-eu-west regions, will keep eu-west pinned until migration completed :shipit:
linda: Thanks folks. updating release notes and sending a short blurb to #product-launches
